tools.name: analyze_invoice
tools.description: Submit one normalized invoice for asynchronous duplicate analysis. Use the returned ID to poll; do not resubmit the same work with a new idempotency key.

tools.name: get_invoice_status
tools.description: Retrieve one analysis owned by the caller's organization. Poll until status is COMPLETED or FAILED.

tools.name: get_invoice_exceptions
tools.description: Retrieve the agent-readable exception packet for one caller-owned invoice.

tools.name: create_purchase_order
tools.description: Register one customer-provided purchase order as the baseline for AP Match. This stores only the caller's data and never writes to an ERP.

tools.name: record_receipt
tools.description: Record a customer-provided goods receipt for a registered purchase order. Use it before a THREE_WAY AP Match; it never updates a warehouse or ERP.

tools.name: match_invoice
tools.description: Run a read-only two- or three-way match against one registered purchase order. Supply exactly one purchase-order identifier.

tools.name: get_invoice_extraction
tools.description: Retrieve canonical fields, OCR confidence, source evidence, and a next action for a submitted invoice.

tools.name: validate_invoice
tools.description: Run deterministic required-field, date, and line-total checks before AP routing. This does not create or alter accounting records.

tools.name: search_invoice_history
tools.description: Find exact and near matches in the caller's own completed invoice history. Scores are explainable, not a fraud probability.

tools.name: upsert_vendor_baseline
tools.description: Create or replace a customer-controlled remittance baseline. Provide a fingerprint, not a raw account number. This is not bank-account ownership verification.

tools.name: check_remittance_change
tools.description: Compare submitted fingerprinted remittance details with a customer-controlled vendor baseline. A change requires human out-of-band verification; this is not bank-account ownership verification.

tools.name: normalize_invoice_lines
tools.description: Private preview. Deterministically normalize customer-supplied invoice descriptions, SKUs, and units. It does not invent missing values.

tools.name: get_invoice_risk_score
tools.description: Private preview. Return the deterministic 0-100 control score, priority band, and named evidence signals for a completed invoice.

tools.name: extract_purchase_order
tools.description: Private preview. Queue one uploaded customer-owned purchase-order document for structured extraction. Poll with get_purchase_order_extraction.

tools.name: get_purchase_order_extraction
tools.description: Private preview. Get the caller-owned PO extraction status, canonical fields, OCR evidence, and next action.

tools.name: save_extracted_purchase_order
tools.description: Private preview. Save a completed extraction as a named PO revision before matching or amendment diffing.

tools.name: diff_purchase_order_amendment
tools.description: Private preview. Compare two saved caller-owned PO revisions and return explicit header, term, and line changes.

tools.name: preflight_erp_bill
tools.description: Check a proposed NetSuite or QuickBooks vendor bill using customer-supplied record references. This tool never connects to or writes to an ERP.

tools.name: preflight_subcontractor_invoice
tools.description: Check a subcontractor invoice against supplied commitment, retainage, schedule-of-values, work, lien-waiver, and insurance evidence. It does not determine legal validity of documents.

tools.name: preflight_freight_invoice
tools.description: Check a freight invoice against supplied shipment, linehaul, fuel, and accessorial policy data. It does not connect to a TMS or carrier system.

tools.name: preflight_franchise_invoice
tools.description: Find exact same-vendor, same-invoice, same-amount duplicates across customer-supplied multi-location history. It never searches another organization’s records.

tools.name: check_procurement_agent_action
tools.description: Evaluate a proposed procurement agent action against supplied budget, authority, category, vendor, contract, and approval policy. It never authorizes a payment or vendor-record change.

tools.name: resolve_vendor_entity
tools.description: Resolve customer-supplied vendor names, aliases, addresses, and domains against customer-provided expectations. It is not official verification.

tools.name: check_vendor_onboarding
tools.description: Check customer-defined supplier onboarding packet completeness. It does not approve or create a vendor.

tools.name: check_tax_form
tools.description: Check W-9 or W-8 form completeness using only a legal name, final four identifier digits, customer signature policy, and supplied dates. It is not tax advice or tax-ID verification.

tools.name: check_vendor_domain_risk
tools.description: Compare a sender email domain with customer-provided approved and prior-domain baselines. Verify changes out of band.

tools.name: compare_quotes
tools.description: Compare customer-provided vendor quote lines and totals. It never selects or sends a quote.

tools.name: extract_contract_obligations
tools.description: Find candidate ISO dates and obligation indicators in supplied contract text. Review results against the source; this is not legal advice.

tools.name: check_certificate_expiry
tools.description: Check expiry windows and customer verification flags for supplied certificate metadata. It does not validate certificate authenticity.

tools.name: match_remittance_advice
tools.description: Match a customer-supplied remittance amount and invoice references to the caller's supplied open-invoice baseline. It never posts a payment.

tools.name: normalize_bank_statement
tools.description: Normalize customer-provided bank transaction records for reconciliation. It never connects to a bank or stores account numbers.

tools.name: match_reconciliation
tools.description: Produce deterministic candidate matches between two caller-provided record sets. It never posts a reconciliation.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: check_vendor_domain_risk, match_remittance_advice · Private data: record_receipt, validate_invoice, normalize_invoice_lines, get_invoice_risk_score, extract_purchase_order, get_purchase_order_extraction, save_extracted_purchase_order, diff_purchase_order_amendment, preflight_erp_bill, preflight_subcontractor_invoice, preflight_franchise_invoice, check_procurement_agent_action, normalize_bank_statement, match_reconciliation · Public sink: analyze_invoice, check_vendor_domain_risk · Destructive: match_invoice, validate_invoice.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: check_vendor_domain_risk, match_remittance_advice · Private data: record_receipt, validate_invoice, normalize_invoice_lines, get_invoice_risk_score, extract_purchase_order, get_purchase_order_extraction, save_extracted_purchase_order, diff_purchase_order_amendment, preflight_erp_bill, preflight_subcontractor_invoice, preflight_franchise_invoice, check_procurement_agent_action, normalize_bank_statement, match_reconciliation · Public sink: analyze_invoice, check_vendor_domain_risk · Destructive: match_invoice, validate_invoice

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
